title: You don't heal from a breakup by finding the right person...
paragraphs:
You don't heal from a breakup by finding the right person...
You heal by returning to the right Savior.
That may not be what the world wants to hear.

We're told to distract ourselves.
Find someone new.
"Move on."
But if your heart is still carrying rejection, bitterness, regret, or shame... changing relationships won't heal what's broken inside.
Only Jesus can restore a heart that has been shattered.
How to Recover After a Breakup Biblically
This isn't another self-help relationship book.
It's a Christ-centered guide that will help you stop chasing closure from people and start finding healing in God's presence.

If you're struggling to let go...
If you're wondering why it still hurts...
If you're asking God, "What now?"...
This book was written for you.
Inside you'll discover:
✅ How to heal without hardening your heart
✅ The biblical way to process grief and disappointment
✅ Why forgiveness is freedom—not weakness
✅ How to stop replaying painful memories
✅ How to rebuild your identity in Christ after rejection
✅ Healthy biblical boundaries that protect your healing
✅ Powerful prayers and Scripture to renew your mind
✅ How God can redeem your pain for His glory
"The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit." — Psalm 34:18
🔥 MOST PEOPLE vs. FEW PEOPLE

Most people...
• Run back to what God delivered them from.
• Look for another relationship to fill the emptiness.
• Let heartbreak define their future.

Few people...
• Let God heal them before moving forward.
• Choose forgiveness over bitterness.
• Discover that Christ is enough—even in the deepest pain.
Be one of the few.
